title: Local ZAFF fit to the QM minus resident GFN2 residual
summary: Fit a local harmonic ZAFF correction so resident GFN2 plus ZAFF has zero gradient and the best available QM Hessian at the best available geometry.
gates: frozen G atom order matches F
G and F provenance retained separately
ZAFF charges exactly zero and ZAFF van der Waals terms absent
ZAFF correction energy exactly zero at G
full Cartesian gradient and Hessian reconstruction report
coordinate_policy: Use frozen SMITH primitive derivatives at G. Align F into the G Cartesian frame and record any residual geometry mismatch.
backend_policy: Use only resident matrix_gfn2.GFN2Calculator for baseline gradient and complete analytic Hessian. Subtract GFN2 once from QM, without any ZAFF electrostatic or van der Waals subtraction; all ZAFF charges are zero and all ZAFF van der Waals terms are absent.
